readings.Aries: The obstacle is smaller than your reaction to it suggests. Recalibrate the response. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Taurus: There is something you've been meaning to create that you keep postponing. Today is not different, but you could make it be. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Gemini: There are two kinds of curiosity — the kind that opens doors and the kind that avoids commitment. Know which you're using. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Cancer: Something that happened long ago is affecting today in ways you haven't fully mapped. Start mapping. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Leo: You've been playing it safe in a context that rewards exactly the kind of risk you're capable of. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Virgo: Your ability to anticipate problems is saving you from some of them and creating others. Know which. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: Something in your physical environment is slightly wrong and it's affecting you more than seems proportionate. Fix it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: There is a transformation available that doesn't require anyone else to change. Only you. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Sagittarius: You have more impact on people than your transience suggests. Take that seriously. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Capricorn: The coldness others perceive is not who you are. It is how you move through uncertain terrain. Let someone know. Let this one be easy.
readings.Aquarius: The relationship that doesn't fit your system is the one that's teaching you something important. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: There is something you've been trying to hold together that wants to fall apart constructively. Let it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

sky_notes: Mercury appears retrograde today. Earth isn't overtaking Mercury — Mercury is lapping us on the inside track, so it appears to drift backwards against the stars. Your western blot is unaffected.
Venus appears retrograde today. Venus is passing between us and the Sun, so it appears to slide backwards for ~6 weeks. Gravity on your bench is unchanged.
Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing crescent: we see a growing sliver of the Moon's sunlit half as it moves ~12° further east of the Sun each day.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1.2° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
